headline: Godcrofts and Fingers Lead Renewed Base Activity
war_summary: The latest ledger shifts the watch northward: Godcrofts has recorded eight strategic-base events in 24 hours, including one in the past two hours and eight in six, with Argosa and Lipsia the chief sites of activity. The Fingers is the freshest flashpoint, posting three events in the last two hours at Headsman’s Villa; its seven bases remain Colonial-held. Lykos Isle also remains unsettled, with eight events in six hours and eleven across the day, though its latest movement was earlier than the current two-hour window; ownership stands four Colonial to three Warden. Deadlands continues as the heaviest contested front by scale, with nine events in 24 hours, but no fresh movement in the latest two-hour watch and a seven-to-four Colonial lead. Farranac Coast likewise has six daily events but none in two hours, retaining a nine-to-two Colonial advantage. Fisherman’s Row has gone quiet since the previous edition’s watch, yet its 14-event day makes it a valuable reserve indicator; eight bases are Warden-held and one Colonial-held. Casualty and enlistment rates are rising sharply in several sectors, but no base events there confirm immediate ownership movement.
